n.no: Keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive-technology entry point. Client architecture only; backend internals are external dependencies.

c.responsibility: Design the browser architecture of a personalized feed with posts, images and likes. The server supplies ranking and privacy-filtered pages. Focus on long sessions, back navigation and reliable interaction while scrolling.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: 10,000 browsed posts, 20 fetched per page; illustrative mounted window of 20 plus 10 overscan; lazy images with reserved aspect ratio.
c.accessibility: Use semantic articles and headings, keyboard-operable like/load-more controls, polite load announcements and stable focus when rows are recycled. Never announce the whole feed on every update.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Use cursor pagination, ID normalization and a variable-height virtualized list. Anchor by post ID plus pixel offset rather than raw scrollTop. Keep new posts behind a New posts button to avoid moving the reader. Alternative: A simple paginated list has better navigation semantics for shorter feeds; virtualization helps very long sessions but complicates variable heights and accessibility.
